pr.title: Render structured log context fields inline in console output
pr.description:
Modify ConsoleFormatter to render all structured context fields (pipeline_id,
agent_role, phase, etc.) as inline key=value pairs on the same log line instead
of on separate newlines. This makes logs grep-friendly in Docker environments
where each line is a separate log entry.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: pytest tests/shared/egg_logging/test_formatters.py
- Manual: Build orchestrator container, run a pipeline, verify `docker logs | grep pipeline_id=<id>` returns full log lines with message + context
pr.manual_steps:
Pre-merge: None
Post-merge: Rebuild orchestrator and gateway Docker images to pick up the change
